Hey Derek, I was elected to fight for Pennsylvania. I’m not asking political insiders for permission to do my job. You may have seen this headline: _"Fetterman Draws Shadow Primary From Democrats Eager to Replace Him"_ — **Bloomberg** Some Democrats want someone else in this seat. But I’m not changing who I am to keep them happy. I answer to the people of Pennsylvania. And I’m going to keep doing what I believe is right, even when my own party doesn’t like it. That means I’ll keep fighting to:
* **Stand up for America** and the Western values of freedom, democracy, individual liberty, and the rule of law.
* **Reject** **socialism** and its extremes ideas.
* **Fight for working-class families** , including the people who too often get overlooked in Washington.
* **Stand firmly with Israel** against terrorism and reject antisemitism wherever it appears.

I’m not backing down. Will you chip in $25 today to help our campaign reach more people and make sure Pennsylvanians hear directly from me? body:
Elon Musk has dropped $366M to keep Republicans in power and defeat our progressive movement. I need your help to fight back.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261023-6876-footer&t=1&akid=6876%2E420207%2E7c7bQE)
Peter, you need to hear this:
Elon Musk has dropped a staggering **$366 million** to keep Republicans in power and defeat our progressive movement — _more than any individual donor in American history._
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261023._g9LLi&refcode=em20261023-6876&t=2&akid=6876%2E420207%2E7c7bQE)
Let that sink in. One billionaire — actually, _trillionaire_ — is pouring nine figures into our elections to decide who holds power in Congress.
In 2010, billionaires spent $32 million to influence our elections. This year, that number is up to _$1.7 billion_.
And we know exactly why they’re doing it.
Right-wing billionaires and trillionaires like Musk want to buy a Congress that will never pass Medicare for All, never make the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share, and never hold powerful corporations accountable. A Congress that protects people at the top, while working people pay the price.
_It’s not going to work, Peter._
All summer, we watched incredible progressive fighters like Abdul El-Sayed, Peggy Flanagan, and Angie Nixon get massively outspent — and they won anyway, **because they had working people on their side.**
Organized people beat organized money. Period.
I’ve never taken a single dime from corporate PACs. Not from anyone trying to buy my vote. So when the ultra-wealthy come at everything we’re fighting for, there’s only one place I can turn: _this people-powered movement._
With less than two weeks left until Election Day, I need you standing with me to make sure we can turn out every voter and have the backs of the progressive candidates on the ballot who are going to help us pass Medicare for All and finally build a government that serves working families.
[**Will you pitch in $3 today to help me keep fighting against the ultra-wealthy trying to buy our democracy?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261023._g9LLi&refcode=em20261023-6876&amount=3&t=3&akid=6876%2E420207%2E7c7bQE)

Peter, you need to hear this: Elon Musk has dropped a staggering $366 million to keep Republicans in power and defeat our progressive movement — more than any individual donor in American history. | | Welcome back to Fact Friday! **Early voting is underway in El Paso, and being prepared can make the voting process easier. Whether you're a first-time voter or a regular at the polls, here are five things to know before you vote:** **1\. Know who is on your ballot.** There's more on the ballot than the races you see on TV — including county offices, city elections, school board positions, and in some cases, local propositions, depending on where you live. Take a few minutes to review your options before you go. [SAMPLE BALLOT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142027417/655554516/436876826?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWIzM2M5Ni1mNWNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f4qKRZW27VXvKDJtpyVw5SbGH69rxL7Kv2oS8IGHHvY=&emci=c065b6a0-f6cb-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=45b33c96-f5ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=14565883) **2\. Know where to vote.** One of the best parts of early voting in El Paso County is that you can cast your ballot at any early voting location. That means you can find a location that works with your schedule, whether it's close to home, work, or somewhere in between. [WHERE TO VOTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142027418/655554517/-571584443?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWIzM2M5Ni1mNWNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f4qKRZW27VXvKDJtpyVw5SbGH69rxL7Kv2oS8IGHHvY=&emci=c065b6a0-f6cb-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=45b33c96-f5ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=14565883) **3\. Know what to bring.** Texas requires an accepted form of photo ID at the polls (like a Texas driver's license or U.S. passport). If you don't have one and can't reasonably obtain one, there are alternative ID options available. [**You can review Texas voter ID requirements here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142027419/655554518/-533882930?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWIzM2M5Ni1mNWNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f4qKRZW27VXvKDJtpyVw5SbGH69rxL7Kv2oS8IGHHvY=&emci=c065b6a0-f6cb-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=45b33c96-f5ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=14565883) **4\. Know your rights.** Every eligible voter has the right to access the ballot and get assistance if needed. If you have questions or need support at your polling place due to a disability or language needs, don't hesitate to ask election officials. **If you experience an issue while voting or have questions about your rights, contact the nonpartisan Election Protection hotline:**
* 1-866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683) — Call or text
* 1-888-VE-Y-VOTA (888-839-8682) — For assistance in Spanish

These resources are available during early voting and on Election Day. **5\. Know your deadlines.**
* **October 30:** Last day of early voting.
* **November 3:** Election Day! (and last day for the local elections office to receive your mail-in ballot)

[**You can find additional information, including voting locations, hours, and election resources, through the El Paso County Elections Department.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142027420/655554519/-1312914512?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWIzM2M5Ni1mNWNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f4qKRZW27VXvKDJtpyVw5SbGH69rxL7Kv2oS8IGHHvY=&emci=c065b6a0-f6cb-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=45b33c96-f5ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=14565883) **Take some time to review your ballot, find a voting location, and make a plan that works for you.** And if you've already voted, you can still share these resources with a friend, family member, or neighbor who might have questions. clean_body: From sample ballots to what to bring, here's everything you need to make a plan. | | | | Welcome back to Fact Friday! Early voting is underway in El Paso, and being prepared can make the voting process easier. Whether you're a first-time voter or a regular at the polls, here are five things to know before you vote: 1\. Know who is on your ballot. There's more on the ballot than the races you see on TV — including county offices, city elections, school board positions, and in some cases, local propositions, depending on where you live. Take a few minutes to review your options before you go. 2\. Know where to vote. One of the best parts of early voting in El Paso County is that you can cast your ballot at any early voting location. That means you can find a location that works with your schedule, whether it's close to home, work, or somewhere in between. 3\. Know what to bring. Texas requires an accepted form of photo ID at the polls (like a Texas driver's license or U.S. passport). If you don't have one and can't reasonably obtain one, there are alternative ID options available. 4\. Know your rights. Every eligible voter has the right to access the ballot and get assistance if needed. If you have questions or need support at your polling place due to a disability or language needs, don't hesitate to ask election officials. If you experience an issue while voting or have questions about your rights, contact the nonpartisan Election Protection hotline: 1-866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683) — Call or text 1-888-VE-Y-VOTA (888-839-8682) — For assistance in Spanish These resources are available during early voting and on Election Day. 5\. Know your deadlines. October 30: Last day of early voting. November 3: Election Day! (and last day for the local elections office to receive your mail-in ballot) Take some time to review your ballot, find a voting location, and make a plan that works for you. And if you've already voted, you can still share these resources with a friend, family member, or neighbor who might have questions. Thank you for taking the time to stay informed and engaged in our democracy. Fellow Patriot,

I sat down with Sean Hannity to talk about this race, and I said what a lot of South Carolinians are already thinking:

**The Democrats are pouring money into this state to flip it blue.**
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=80e393c76b0b4fb484a9c20a8e25f7f8&_e=Epultp-uAZcVVVtpf_mzbiPZB8AyNp4z2esTWHUgfUmn9i83bGHaDjbDALIDCs4jpXGMdYP1FAUc3SBFyR3H-oGx9Jv-d8jVg91riqpWFTp6X_9TUUjtkAajl8hjVIjae6KLnKU25q6QXrSWR6j87Tj3qLfUnBmDAWIaTlblRyybFF2pTy_JXFwy08OKsrvaEoGAzKDxmm0o48DEzcGT4dAkQDbX0hoYX-kNQEAbiFFDm1iTlju7HPyoSUDrvO7ZT64eWXT3X-2-jomN-1ZzKy94xVdQ7XT3XdOt5NJDZo1zBSs1acCZN9VHUHbQnSMd_ag7hMAhAbX7a6KDluZvY_lbxvt_vqiu4GWG6TGfwtj3oNrMyQXS-iqtYuZXe3qeioa7y2SHBZ_BIYfsiiNeVhDL-qIBRpXOC46XiYnWAkX7-0jPntHt3BBCARIUWrJO-J69K2D62mE-h-kAD2musduDOG-fG6t8e7ID62oZtBTj9D7LEt5MolWYTe-CKRshdqClQC7P_Z_h6U8paXZRVB4od6waPmD2Ld-zxntKIiifSe4Jix4DY_H3H9mQjyuc3OL9w8hnB2eS7QhSFFJHtG90L2zVWqCoD097H2lk7KWGnbMRalxPo74lwdB2c4JfMHhCl3W00omKdM3gLWYqHJoFtdfp32tlvHboNmfaLcyPC9tYQh3RfKi958Akld9MAWfQaG3P4FKFYvzFG0HMne-rCQXJrdIZJ7dg_-kvHh-txsOcQkfY6tLRxdwBlkAx8onjakMQmLQGmjrEgjmT1GAZsuA91RpYkLLz9_XFT-45I9i5EdxMbL6F5I1cL-63)

# Iran
* **Trump accuses Iran of driving up oil prices as Brent crude hits $114:** President Donald Trump accused Iran of deliberately attempting to raise global oil prices ahead of the November midterm elections.
* "Iran is doing everything they can to drive up the price of Oil prior to the U.S. Midterm Election," Trump [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/c5cbe0fc-1d26-475a-bbe4-aa071181c736?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Truth Social. "They are even making up fake hits, mines, and everything else," he claimed, insisting that more oil is now passing through the Strait of Hormuz than before the war began.
* Middle East Gulf and Gulf of Oman oil and petroleum product exports, excluding Iran, [fell](https://substack.com/redirect/024fe2fe-ab16-40a2-a94f-61b5c5efc231?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to around 15 million barrels per day (bpd) on a seven-day moving average, down from a pre-war baseline of 20.5 million bpd, according to Kpler data. Kpler says data from the past two weeks may be revised upward.
* Brent crude [hit](https://substack.com/redirect/43a75378-3606-4e9d-b8c3-7548bb679140?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a high of $114.72 overnight. The U.S. national average price for regular gasoline sits at $4.284 per gallon, a 5-cent drop from last week; diesel fuel now averages $6.276 per gallon, a 10-cent increase.
* **Europe faces winter energy crisis, IEA chief warns:** Europe is entering winter with historically low natural gas reserves and cannot withstand further supply disruptions caused by the U.S. war with Iran, the International Energy Agency chief Fatih Birol [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/8b62544f-34dc-4569-846e-9537ed2a8571?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* EU gas storage is just 72% full, compared with the usual 90% ahead of winter, a shortfall equivalent to the energy needs of 10 to 12 million homes. Nearly 10% of Europe's liquefied natural gas previously passed through the Strait of Hormuz, where attacks on vessels have disrupted shipping.
* "Life will not be easy for Europe this year and also next year," Birol told Al Jazeera, adding that even an immediate ceasefire would not prevent higher energy costs in the coming months. Birol also warned of diesel shortages linked to Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries.
* "I have never ever seen the dark and long shadow of geopolitics so dominant in the energy sector," Birol said. "Energy is not currently considered a business but a political leverage."
* **U.S. spent $11 billion in three years defending Israel, analysis finds:** The U.S. fired an estimated 609 missile interceptors to defend Israeli territory between October 2023 and June 2026, costing approximately $11 billion in taxpayer money, according to an [analysis](https://substack.com/redirect/3f2bda8e-bd6c-4c08-bcf5-2838826246b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by researcher Stephen Semler. The estimate excludes interceptors fired to defend U.S. forces in the region.
* "That is not a symbiotic relationship. It is a parasitic one," Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/7cb61e24-b602-4dc7-94a0-0cf6036a6833?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X, sharing the analysis.
* **UAE closes Umm Al Quwain beaches after oil spill from tanker:** The UAE [temporarily closed](https://substack.com/redirect/9b18f237-4c6b-4021-b34c-4835a7dc9c11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) all beaches and coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain after an oil spill from a tanker contaminated the shoreline.
* The spill comes amid escalating Iranian attacks on commercial vessels and oil tankers in and around the Strait of Hormuz. UAE authorities did not link the spill to the war. Other regional spills, including oil slicks near Iran's Qeshm and Hengam islands and along Oman's coastline, were caused by attacks on vessels in the region.
* **U.S. claims naval blockade prevented Iran from exporting $25 billion in oil over 100 days:** The naval blockade of Iran prevented at least $25 billion worth of Iranian crude oil exports since it resumed 100 days ago, CENTCOM claimed in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/9776dfb1-437e-4dca-8a67-e9acb70ce69f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X. CENTCOM claimed that due to the blockade, dubbed "America's steel wall," no goods have entered or left Iran by sea, except for "humanitarian shipments U.S. forces have allowed."

# Palestine
* **Three Palestinians killed, several wounded in Israeli strikes across Gaza:** Two Palestinians were killed and others wounded on Friday in an Israeli [airstrike](https://substack.com/redirect/ec6e3dab-2edb-4ee3-895f-9f48f769a341?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the Al-Nasr neighborhood of western Gaza City, according to WAFA.
* In southern Gaza, an Israeli drone strike targeting a bicycle on Al-Qubba Street, west of Khan Younis, killed one Palestinian and wounded others.
* **Netanyahu orders full closure of West Bank after Hebron shooting:** Two Palestinian gunmen [opened fire](https://substack.com/redirect/935e2636-e567-44a1-a31a-294acf1e1ee2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at an Israeli military checkpoint near Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday, killing two Israeli soldiers and wounding three others before being killed by Israeli forces. The gunfight lasted more than 20 minutes.
* Israeli forces then imposed a sweeping military lockdown on Hebron governorate, closing all entrances and exits, and preventing Palestinian movement. Troops raided homes and [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/5eb4ec4b-ee1a-477c-b612-da278b5271b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least five Palestinians in raids, according to WAFA. Israeli forces also [critically wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/7981745d-9ce1-4b12-a90f-d652b3c604a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Palestinian driver after shooting him in the chest in Dura, southwest of Hebron, and closed the Ibrahimi Mosque to Muslim worshippers.
* During a subsequent visit to Hebron on Friday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced he had instructed the army and security forces to "immediately impose a closure on the city of Hebron" and prepare for a "full lockdown" of the entire West Bank starting Friday.
* Netanyahu added that along with Defense Minister Israel Katz they were considering an extensive operation in the West Bank "such as has not been carried out since the Six Day War," in reference to 1967.
* Netanyahu announced plans to apply the same "successful and aggressive model" used in the occupied West Bank refugee camps, where Israeli forces have displaced tens of thousands of residents and demolished large areas in what rights groups [have said](https://substack.com/redirect/86acbf21-935d-4dde-baea-2fa6e638eba7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are crimes against humanity.
* **Israeli settlers and soldiers rampage across the occupied West Bank:**

# Yemen
* **Ansarallah claims Saudi Arabia rejected five-day ceasefire proposal for talks:** Senior Ansarallah official Mohammed Al-Bukhaiti [said](https://substack.com/redirect/ceacd207-fadc-4c38-b0d3-14be882ad72a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that while Riyadh sought mediation through Oman during the initial escalation in July, Saudi Arabia did not accept a proposed five-day ceasefire for direct talks. * **Jared Kushner received $2 billion in dark money from Gulf States:** U.S. special envoy and Trump son-in-law **Jared Kushner** received $2 billion in a slush fund created by top Emirati and Saudi officials, according to an [excerpt](https://substack.com/redirect/147aa4c9-1b33-4a7f-a281-d17f1d7d064f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a new book by investigative reporter **Matthew Cole**. * Kushner denied Cole's reporting as "categorically false" and "completely insane" in a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/9eb96b65-8380-464b-8001-9907b26a0eff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday. * **CBS: Hegseth bans Pentagon personnel from using nonpublic information to bet on U.S. military operations:** War Secretary **Pete Hegseth** barred department personnel from using classified or unclassified nonpublic information to bet on military operations, he wrote in an October 20 memo to senior Pentagon leaders and combatant commanders that was [obtained](https://substack.com/redirect/bc8619d3-21fa-4201-b807-337eeda7aa9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by CBS News. In April, Army Master Sgt. **Gannon Ken Van Dyke** , a Special Forces soldier involved in the operation that captured **Nicol as Maduro**, was arrested for allegedly betting more than $33,000 on Polymarket on Maduro's removal within hours of President Trump's January announcement, winning more than $409,000. He pleaded not guilty in federal court in New York.
* **ProPublica: Postal Service cuts cause sharp rise in ballot rejections during midterms:** In counties where the Postal Service reduced pickups from twice a day to once a day in rural areas, late-ballot rejection rates were two or three times higher than they were in 2022, ProPublica [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/7f284998-fd29-44be-b2f9-9224371d889d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). * **WSJ: DOJ corruption probe examines Corey Lewandowski:** The Justice Department is [examining](https://substack.com/redirect/92199eb8-11b7-4d9f-8142-73e92038a212?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) whether **Corey Lewandowski** , top adviser to then-Homeland Security Secretary **Kristi Noem** , profited from his political position, the Wall Street Journal [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/92199eb8-11b7-4d9f-8142-73e92038a212?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). # Other International News
* **Egypt editor faces trial in escalated press crackdown:** Lina Attalah, the editor-in-chief of Mada Masr, one of Egypt's last remaining independent media outlets, was referred to trial on Thursday. The escalation comes one day after prosecutors questioned her for more than six hours. Rights groups describe her case as an unprecedented attack on press freedoms in Egypt.
* The Supreme State Prosecution referred Attalah to trial on a charge of establishing and managing a website without a license. She was also questioned on a charge of publishing false news, but that charge was not included in her court referral.
* Atallah was released Wednesday evening on bail of 100,000 Egyptian pounds (around $1,800). She is due in court on October 27. If convicted, she faces a fine of one million to three million Egyptian pounds (roughly $18,000 to $54,000). The court may also order the closure of Mada Masr and the confiscation of its equipment.
* Over 100 independent media outlets and civil society organizations around the world, including Drop Site News, signed a joint [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/b18cb593-75e6-4164-b484-aa155412e5f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) condemning Attalah's referral to trial, calling it "an unprecedented escalation that threatens the future of the entire independent media, knowledge production, and civil society space in Egypt."
* Drop Site News and Mada Masr have co-published several articles over the past two years. Examples **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/cec7e65b-7002-4b2a-9b72-09fe089ef0e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/fea9244d-2dd3-45cd-bb9d-1e75857f27a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

The SAF attacks also reached Babanusa, a city in West Kordofan.

* **Hundreds flee Ethiopia fighting for Kenya** : Hundreds of Ethiopians, mainly women and children, [fled](https://substack.com/redirect/4b62d3a5-0668-4a7c-9f75-ecc7c14f44b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Kenya after fighting erupted in an Ethiopian town near the Kenyan border on Wednesday. One Red Cross official said, "No camp is ready to host those displaced but we shall most definitely work on it." The fighting is hundreds of miles from the Tigray conflict between government forces and the rebel alliance.
* **Tunisian police fire tear gas at protesters after detainee 's death:** Police in Tunis [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/b40ce9b4-75c7-46a2-9528-bb01902fc421?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) tear gas to disperse protesters gathered to oppose the death of a man detained on suspicion of drug dealing. Protesters threw stones at police, obstructed roads, and burned tires. According to the detainee's family, he died from police violence after his arrest. Local media said he died after swallowing drugs.
* **Major earthquake kills 16 in Tibet:** A magnitude 7 earthquake in northern Tibet on Thursday night killed 16 people and injured at least 76 others, Reuters [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/7c989b6d-1e87-479d-acf8-e3e98bbebfd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The epicenter was in a sparsely populated, high-altitude county in China's southwestern region of Tibet. It is the strongest quake to hit the country since early 2024.
* **Musk restores Ukraine 's Starlink access, Trump says: **SpaceX CEO Elon Musk renewed Ukraine's Starlink access, Trump [told](https://substack.com/redirect/9a26b6bf-4b0e-4654-b5a6-7fa025eb38d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reporters on Thursday. Ukraine relies on the satellite technology for battlefield communications and drone operations.
* **10,000+ rally in student-led protest against Serbia 's ruling party on eve of election**: Tens of thousands of people [rallied](https://substack.com/redirect/99d22841-6529-430a-8f28-70bee163f1e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a student-led protest in Belgrade on Thursday, as President Aleksandar Vucic held a rival rally at a sports hall across town. The election comes after almost two years of protests against political corruption.
* **Germany arrests Ukrainian national on suspicion of spying for Russia** : Germany arrested a Ukrainian man that prosecutors say was spying for Russia, officials [said](https://substack.com/redirect/cb5ad9cf-a91e-4bdf-bd52-6e58604bb1ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz addressed the arrest on Thursday, telling reporters that he was "not surprised" by the arrest.

This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday Iran Trump accuses Iran of driving up oil prices as Brent crude hits $114: President Donald Trump accused Iran of deliberately attempting to raise global oil prices ahead of the November midterm elections. "Iran is doing everything they can to drive up the price of Oil prior to the U.S. Midterm Election," Trump on Truth Social. "They are even making up fake hits, mines, and everything else," he claimed, insisting that more oil is now passing through the Strait of Hormuz than before the war began. Middle East Gulf and Gulf of Oman oil and petroleum product exports, excluding Iran, to around 15 million barrels per day (bpd) on a seven-day moving average, down from a pre-war baseline of 20.5 million bpd, according to Kpler data. Kpler says data from the past two weeks may be revised upward. Brent crude a high of $114.72 overnight. The U.S. national average price for regular gasoline sits at $4.284 per gallon, a 5-cent drop from last week; diesel fuel now averages $6.276 per gallon, a 10-cent increase. Europe faces winter energy crisis, IEA chief warns: Europe is entering winter with historically low natural gas reserves and cannot withstand further supply disruptions caused by the U.S. war with Iran, the International Energy Agency chief Fatih Birol . EU gas storage is just 72% full, compared with the usual 90% ahead of winter, a shortfall equivalent to the energy needs of 10 to 12 million homes. Nearly 10% of Europe's liquefied natural gas previously passed through the Strait of Hormuz, where attacks on vessels have disrupted shipping. "Life will not be easy for Europe this year and also next year," Birol told Al Jazeera, adding that even an immediate ceasefire would not prevent higher energy costs in the coming months. Birol also warned of diesel shortages linked to Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries. "I have never ever seen the dark and long shadow of geopolitics so dominant in the energy sector," Birol said. "Energy is not currently considered a business but a political leverage." U.S. spent $11 billion in three years defending Israel, analysis finds: The U.S. fired an estimated 609 missile interceptors to defend Israeli territory between October 2023 and June 2026, costing approximately $11 billion in taxpayer money, according to an by researcher Stephen Semler. The estimate excludes interceptors fired to defend U.S. forces in the region. "That is not a symbiotic relationship. It is a parasitic one," Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on X, sharing the analysis. UAE closes Umm Al Quwain beaches after oil spill from tanker: The UAE all beaches and coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain after an oil spill from a tanker contaminated the shoreline. The spill comes amid escalating Iranian attacks on commercial vessels and oil tankers in and around the Strait of Hormuz. UAE authorities did not link the spill to the war. Other regional spills, including oil slicks near Iran's Qeshm and Hengam islands and along Oman's coastline, were caused by attacks on vessels in the region. U.S. claims naval blockade prevented Iran from exporting $25 billion in oil over 100 days: The naval blockade of Iran prevented at least $25 billion worth of Iranian crude oil exports since it resumed 100 days ago, CENTCOM claimed in a on X. CENTCOM claimed that due to the blockade, dubbed "America's steel wall," no goods have entered or left Iran by sea, except for "humanitarian shipments U.S. forces have allowed." Palestine Three Palestinians killed, several wounded in Israeli strikes across Gaza: Two Palestinians were killed and others wounded on Friday in an Israeli on the Al-Nasr neighborhood of western Gaza City, according to WAFA. In southern Gaza, an Israeli drone strike targeting a bicycle on Al-Qubba Street, west of Khan Younis, killed one Palestinian and wounded others. Netanyahu orders full closure of West Bank after Hebron shooting: Two Palestinian gunmen at an Israeli military checkpoint near Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday, killing two Israeli soldiers and wounding three others before being killed by Israeli forces. The gunfight lasted more than 20 minutes. Israeli forces then imposed a sweeping military lockdown on Hebron governorate, closing all entrances and exits, and preventing Palestinian movement. Troops raided homes and at least five Palestinians in raids, according to WAFA. Israeli forces also a Palestinian driver after shooting him in the chest in Dura, southwest of Hebron, and closed the Ibrahimi Mosque to Muslim worshippers. During a subsequent visit to Hebron on Friday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced he had instructed the army and security forces to "immediately impose a closure on the city of Hebron" and prepare for a "full lockdown" of the entire West Bank starting Friday. Netanyahu added that along with Defense Minister Israel Katz they were considering an extensive operation in the West Bank "such as has not been carried out since the Six Day War," in reference to 1967. Netanyahu announced plans to apply the same "successful and aggressive model" used in the occupied West Bank refugee camps, where Israeli forces have displaced tens of thousands of residents and demolished large areas in what rights groups are crimes against humanity. Israeli settlers and soldiers rampage across the occupied West Bank: Ramallah: Settlers dozens of olive trees in the Al-Qibla area south of Burqa on Friday, WAFA reported. In Sinjil, settlers attacked olive harvesters and broke branches off fruit-bearing trees. Nablus: Israeli forces tear gas canisters toward Palestinians in the agricultural plains of Salem and Beit Furik, igniting fires. In Burin, settlers attempted to set fire to a Palestinian home and its surroundings under Israeli military protection. Jenin: Israeli forces gave families in Khirbet Suruj one week to evacuate their homes and agricultural structures. The community includes more than seven homes and ten livestock sheds, with families who have lived there since 1950 and hold land documents dating back to 1960. East Jerusalem: Israeli forces Sheikh Khaled Abu Jumaa, the Al-Aqsa Mosque preacher, after he delivered the Friday sermon and led prayers at the mosque. Israeli settlers destroy Shireen Abu Akleh memorial: Armed settlers a memorial to Palestinian-American journalist Shireen Abu Akleh near the entrance to the village of Ajja south of Jenin city. The memorial was erected in 2022 to honor the Al Jazeera journalist, who was shot in the head and killed by Israeli forces while covering a military raid on Jenin refugee camp on May 11, 2022. Yemen Ansarallah claims Saudi Arabia rejected five-day ceasefire proposal for talks: Senior Ansarallah official Mohammed Al-Bukhaiti that while Riyadh sought mediation through Oman during the initial escalation in July, Saudi Arabia did not accept a proposed five-day ceasefire for direct talks. In an interview with The Grayzone's Max Blumenthal, Al-Bukhaiti said that Ansarallah had agreed to the proposal. Al-Bukhaiti claimed Ansarallah forces captured Mount Han overlooking Taiz, the major southwestern city under siege, while insisting that any future peace agreement end the war and blockades imposed by both sides. He also called on Saudi Arabia's ruling family to oust Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, saying his continued rule threatens the kingdom itself. "We will support any move within the ruling family ... to oust bin Salman," he said, urging action by Saudi citizens and opposition groups. Saudi-led coalition launches strikes across Yemen as Saudi Arabia intercepts Ansarallah missiles: At least 18 airstrikes were reported across Yemen's Saada, Hodeidah, Al-Jawf, Amran, and Taiz governorates, according to Ansarallah-affiliated media. Saudi Arabia: Air defenses intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles launched by Ansarallah toward Riyadh and Khamis Mushait, in southwestern Saudi Arabia, Saudi-led coalition spokesperson Turki Al-Maliki said. Lebanon Israeli airstrikes, artillery shelling reported in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire: Israeli warplanes an airstrike near Ali Al-Taher Hill, while intermittent Israeli artillery shelling targeted the outskirts of Zawtar Al-Sharqiya on Friday in the Nabatieh district, according to Lebanon's National News Agency. In the Marjayoun district, Israeli forces reportedly to wooded areas in the town of Qantara. U.S. News Jared Kushner received $2 billion in dark money from Gulf States: U.S. special envoy and Trump son-in-law Jared Kushner received $2 billion in a slush fund created by top Emirati and Saudi officials, according to an of a new book by investigative reporter Matthew Cole. Cole reports an extraordinary sequence of events that began with Russian intelligence infiltrating Kushner's iPhone. According to Cole, Dutch intelligence captured a Russian agent, flipped him, and gained access to Kushner's device themselves. As they began to monitor Kushner's phone in real time, they observed suspicious transfers of huge amounts of money. According to Cole, UAE ruler Mohamed bin Zayed and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman sought to influence U.S. foreign policy during the first Trump term, and offered Kushner the money toward that end. The arrangement also involved Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who directed Kushner in 2018 to set up an account at the Israeli Central Bank. Netanyahu reportedly required Kushner to inform him before moving any money out of the account. Kushner denied Cole's reporting as "categorically false" and "completely insane" in a on Thursday. Through his attorney, Kushner said he would legal action against the publisher of Cole's book, Simon & Schuster. The full excerpt from the book published in Vanity Fair is available . Cole's book, "Princes and Thieves: Jared Kushner and Mohamed bin Zayed's Secret Plot to Remake the Middle East," will be released on October 27. It can be pre-ordered . CBS: Hegseth bans Pentagon personnel from using nonpublic information to bet on U.S. military operations: War Secretary Pete Hegseth barred department personnel from using classified or unclassified nonpublic information to bet on military operations, he wrote in an October 20 memo to senior Pentagon leaders and combatant commanders that was by CBS News. The memo names prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi, and says that violations could bring administrative discipline or criminal action under federal law or the Uniform Code of Military Justice. The directive follows scrutiny of military-related betting. In April, Army Master Sgt. Gannon Ken Van Dyke , a Special Forces soldier involved in the operation that captured Nicol as Maduro, was arrested for allegedly betting more than $33,000 on Polymarket on Maduro's removal within hours of President Trump's January announcement, winning more than $409,000. He pleaded not guilty in federal court in New York. ProPublica: Postal Service cuts cause sharp rise in ballot rejections during midterms: In counties where the Postal Service reduced pickups from twice a day to once a day in rural areas, late-ballot rejection rates were two or three times higher than they were in 2022, ProPublica . In 11 rural counties of Washington, for instance, nearly 2,000 ballots arrived late this year, compared to about 600 in 2022. Judge restricts DHS investigations of supposed noncitizen voting: U.S. District Judge Araceli Mart inez-Olguin portions of the Department of Homeland Security's aggressive investigations of supposed noncitizens. The order bars the DHS from stopping or interviewing suspects in nine states. The judge found the plaintiffs--including National Nurses United and Voto Latino--likely to succeed in their claim that the DHS investigations infringe upon the Voting Rights Act. "The public's interest in safe elections, free from interference or intimidation," she , "far exceed defendants' purported interest in combating unlawful voting by non-U.S. citizens." WSJ: DOJ corruption probe examines Corey Lewandowski: The Justice Department is whether Corey Lewandowski , top adviser to then-Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem , profited from his political position, the Wall Street Journal . The inquiry rests on a recent referral from the DHS inspector general. It focuses, in part, on contracting fraud. The review is the first publicly known instance of Trump's second-term DOJ scrutinizing someone close to the president. Investigators found evidence Lewandowski may have been involved in improperly awarding contracts. He or his close associates approved almost all spending above $100,000, and he personally signed contracts despite serving as an unpaid Special Government Employee. Lewandowski, through a representative, denied wrongdoing. DOJ charges 15 in health care fraud worth nearly $2 billion: The Justice Department 15 defendants, including six medical professionals, with luring vulnerable patients into needless surgeries, sham treatment programs, and bogus hospice care. In one case, two people allegedly paid Texas "body brokers" to recruit homeless people and 12-step participants into sham California sober living homes, where they were signed up for pricey insurance and then left to languish in "decrepit squats." In another case, three people allegedly pressured healthy seniors into hospice care. Musk gives another $76 million to America PAC; his total midterm donations now $442+ million : Elon Musk $76 million to his super PAC, America PAC, in the first two weeks of October, pushing his total donations above $442 million this election cycle. His giving in 2026 far exceeds the roughly $290 million he spent in 2024. Musk's earlier spending includes $158 million to the campaign arm of Senate Republicans, which was then transferred to a super PAC boosting Texas AG Ken Paxton in his tight race against Democrat James Talarico. He has given to many other groups: the House Republicans super PAC, Trump's MAGA Inc., a group seeking to repeal Alaska's ranked-choice voting, and various GOP candidates. Musk has not campaigned with GOP candidates this fall, unlike in prior years, and Republicans privately acknowledge he could be politically toxic. Axios: Major U.S. banks discover third-party AI agents in customer accounts : Top U.S. banks are discovering unauthorized AI agents inside customer accounts, Axios on Thursday. Most cases involve an AI agent or assistant using a customer's login credentials with their permission--which is still a violation of most banks' rules. But some banks have also found AI agents that contact call centers or take actions that appear independent of user instructions. Ohio governor 's race now "leans Democratic," per analysis: The nonpartisan election newsletter Sabato's Crystal Ball the Ohio governor's race toward Democratic nominee Amy Acton , citing "an explosive--and desperate--attack ad" by Republican Vivek Ramaswamy. The ad features Acton's estranged mother, Donna Arthur, who says, "She lies about her past. She says she grew up living in a tent. None of that is true. She's lied her entire life." Ramaswamy's campaign confirmed that it was behind the ad and said it would spend $4 million to promote it. Acton has openly discussed her experience of childhood abuse, neglect, and homelessness. Virginia state senator charged with conspiracy, bribery, racketeering: Virginia state Senator Louise Lucas , 82, was on charges related to marijuana distribution, bribery, and racketeering on Thursday. Six other co-defendants were charged, including her daughters Lisa Lucas-Burke and Theresa Lucas-Lamb and her grandson Ryan Eichelberger. Prosecutors say that since at least 2019, Lucas led a scheme that used her political influence to enact legislation and regulations benefiting herself and co-defendants and shielding a marijuana enterprise from state law enforcement. Federal agents searched her office and The Cannabis Outlet, a shop she co-owns, nearly six months ago, and the investigation reportedly began under President Joe Biden. 📥 Have a tip on Capitol Hill? Email DC Correspondent Julian Andreone at Julian@dropsitenews.com Other International News Egypt editor faces trial in escalated press crackdown: Lina Attalah, the editor-in-chief of Mada Masr, one of Egypt's last remaining independent media outlets, was referred to trial on Thursday. The escalation comes one day after prosecutors questioned her for more than six hours. Rights groups describe her case as an unprecedented attack on press freedoms in Egypt. The Supreme State Prosecution referred Attalah to trial on a charge of establishing and managing a website without a license. She was also questioned on a charge of publishing false news, but that charge was not included in her court referral. Atallah was released Wednesday evening on bail of 100,000 Egyptian pounds (around $1,800). She is due in court on October 27. If convicted, she faces a fine of one million to three million Egyptian pounds (roughly $18,000 to $54,000). The court may also order the closure of Mada Masr and the confiscation of its equipment. Over 100 independent media outlets and civil society organizations around the world, including Drop Site News, signed a joint condemning Attalah's referral to trial, calling it "an unprecedented escalation that threatens the future of the entire independent media, knowledge production, and civil society space in Egypt." Drop Site News and Mada Masr have co-published several articles over the past two years. Examples and . Six killed, 28 wounded in church funeral shooting in Jordan: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan on Friday, six people and wounding 28 others. The church is located in Karak, home to a minority Christian population. King Abdullah II condemned the shooting as a terrorist attack. "Those who delude themselves into thinking that they can divide Jordanians with their bullets have no chance in the face of our unity," he . Sudanese army strikes Darfur, Kordofan: Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) attacks Rapid Support Forces (RSF) positions and civilian infrastructure in El Fasher, in Sudan's western region of Darfur. The strikes destroyed military equipment and civilian property, and damaged the Sultan Ali Dinar Mosque. In East Darfur, SAF strikes destroyed RSF military vehicles, gas trucks and civilian cars. The SAF attacks also reached Babanusa, a city in West Kordofan. Mob beats immigrant to death in South Africa: A mob of about 50 people and killed an immigrant during an anti-immigration protest in Durban, South Africa, on Thursday. Local officials did not share the victim's nationality, or provide details of the protest. For months, Durban has been the center of xenophobic demonstrations. Tens of thousands of migrants have left South Africa in recent months in one of the largest mass exoduses in years. WHO says Ebola outbreak is becoming "more complex"; infections in three African countries: "We are facing a more complex outbreak landscape," a World Health Organization official of the spread of Ebola. Cases have been announced in Nigeria, Kenya, and Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak originated in Congo in May. To date, it has killed more than 4,000 people there. Syria security force raids suspected ISIS cell; seven dead : A on a suspected ISIS cell near Damascus resulted in the deaths of two Syrian security force personnel and five suspected ISIS members, according to Syrian officials. Security forces arrested six other suspected members, and seized weapons and explosive belts. In recent weeks, the Interior Ministry has said it has stopped an ISIS plot in the Damascus countryside, dismantled an ISIS cell in Homs, and a top ISIS military commander. Hundreds flee Ethiopia fighting for Kenya : Hundreds of Ethiopians, mainly women and children, to Kenya after fighting erupted in an Ethiopian town near the Kenyan border on Wednesday. It was not clear what triggered the violence, and the Kenya Red Cross said it is assessing the number of refugees and their needs. One Red Cross official said, "No camp is ready to host those displaced but we shall most definitely work on it." The fighting is hundreds of miles from the Tigray conflict between government forces and the rebel alliance. Tunisian police fire tear gas at protesters after detainee 's death: Police in Tunis tear gas to disperse protesters gathered to oppose the death of a man detained on suspicion of drug dealing. Protesters threw stones at police, obstructed roads, and burned tires. According to the detainee's family, he died from police violence after his arrest. Local media said he died after swallowing drugs. Major earthquake kills 16 in Tibet: A magnitude 7 earthquake in northern Tibet on Thursday night killed 16 people and injured at least 76 others, Reuters . The epicenter was in a sparsely populated, high-altitude county in China's southwestern region of Tibet. It is the strongest quake to hit the country since early 2024. Musk restores Ukraine 's Starlink access, Trump says: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk renewed Ukraine's Starlink access, Trump reporters on Thursday. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that Trump called Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink. Ukraine relies on the satellite technology for battlefield communications and drone operations. 10,000+ rally in student-led protest against Serbia 's ruling party on eve of election: Tens of thousands of people at a student-led protest in Belgrade on Thursday, as President Aleksandar Vucic held a rival rally at a sports hall across town. The Student List, a leaderless movement of student-backed candidates, is running a slate of 250 anti-corruption candidates for the 250-seat parliament, aiming to unseat Vucic's Serbian Progressive Party, which has held power for over 14 years. The election comes after almost two years of protests against political corruption. Germany arrests Ukrainian national on suspicion of spying for Russia : Germany arrested a Ukrainian man that prosecutors say was spying for Russia, officials Thursday. According to federal prosecutors, the man had been in contact with Russian intelligence since at least July 2025, and gathered intelligence on military equipment and weaponry, and personnel and installations affiliated with NATO defenses. Before I ask you to **[chip in $20](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142028938/655560586/-365778044?refcode=em-10.23.26-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzcxNDcxOC1mOGNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MtDeFtMSlZ2RSZrnV0VtVDRyG5sRcHsMFA4pn-0jklM=)** , I want you to know what's at stake in this race:
* **Ohio Republicans – including my MAGA opponent, Robert Sprague – are trying to undermine the will of voters across the state.** He’s been in lockstep with Trump and has repeated baseless claims of “voter fraud,” endorsed restrictions on mail-in voting, and wants to end the use of ballot drop boxes.

* **Whoever wins this race will be in charge of certifying election results, oversee constitutional amendments, and sit on the Ohio Redistricting Commission.** Ohio Republicans have tried to gerrymander the state in Trump’s favor, along with making it more difficult for citizens to get a people-backed referendum on the ballot.

Hi y'all -- it's Gina.
We're on the ground hitting cities from San Antonio to Odessa for my _One Fight_ get out the vote (GOTV) tour. We're on college campuses and in the towns Abbott hardly ever visits. People are fed up with the status quo and ready for change in Texas.
Young people on college campuses couldn't be more fired up about this race because they finally feel like they have a gubernatorial candidate committed to fighting for the things that matter most -- lowering costs, ending the data center takeover, and increasing access to healthcare.
We're in the final 11 days of our race. The fact of the matter is, we are effectively tied against Greg Abbott. That means we are going to have to see record voter turnout in order to win in the few short days we have left before Election Day. **[At the end of this email, I'm hoping you will chip in $5 or more to help us stay on the road, connecting with donors, and turning out the vote.](https://substack.com/redirect/92a6661f-3ff1-451f-9c1e-fca86b75eec5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
But first, my team put together a memo that lays out the stakes of the race to help explain why your support is more critical than ever.
We're almost at the finish line -- and I am so proud of how far we've come and all that we've managed to build in the past year, but we're not done yet.
-- Gina
* * *
**OCTOBER 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV**
**FROM:** Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas
**TO:** Interested Parties
Let me tell you where this race actually stands -- because what's happening in Texas right now is something I don't think the national establishment fully understands yet.
**Gina Hinojosa is leading Greg Abbott in six of the most recent polls. That 's never happened before.**
This race is closer than ever but some people still don't believe we can win -- that's exactly why I'm writing this memo. And it's exactly why this race could slip away if we don't act.
Here's the polling picture. This race has moved steadily and dramatically in Gina's direction since the spring:
* Texas Politics Project (April 2026): Abbott +5
* TPOR (July 2026): Abbott +3, inside the margin of error
* N+ Univision (September 9): Tied 47-47, with Gina leading Latino voters by 12
* ReconMR/Siena (September 17): **Gina leads 49 -45** -- independents breaking for Gina 65-27
* NPR/Marist (September 23): **Gina leads 49 -46**, winning independents 52-39, pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans
* NYT/Siena (October 4): **Gina leads 49 -46**, winning independents 55-39, and leading among Latino voters by 31 points
* YouGov (October 2026): **Gina +1**
* GBAO Poll (October 13): **Gina +2**
* UT/Texas Politics Project (October 14): **Gina +1**

Both RealClearPolitics and Nate Silver's Silver Bulletin have the polling average at about 2 points. _This is a true toss-up._
**Abbott is outspending us 10 to 1 -- and he still isn't getting the result he wants.**
Between July 30 and September 8 alone, Abbott outspent Gina $28 million to $2 million on advertising. Over the full race, he's spent $47 million to our $5 million. Despite that, Gina leads in six of the most recent polls. Abbott's favorability has gone deeply negative -- 45% favorable, 53% unfavorable -- and his job approval has flipped the same way. He's even polling 13% unfavorable among his own Republicans.
Abbott is a damaged incumbent with a nine-figure war chest. The only thing keeping this race from breaking open is the spending gap.
But here's the truth: The more money Abbott spends lying about Gina's record, the more vulnerable we are. _We have to raise more money to reach the voters who haven 't heard from us yet._
**Something real is happening on the ground -- and Republicans know it.**
Lifelong conservative voters are publicly breaking with Abbott over two issues.
On education: conservative moms who backed Abbott before are now appearing at Gina's events, frustrated by a decade of voucher schemes and defunded public schools. Gina is running an ad featuring a self-described MAGA conservative who protested on January 6 -- and is now voting for Gina because of schools.
On data centers: rural Republican protest groups -- including one in Lubbock led by Republicans -- are furious about unregulated expansion driving up electricity bills. Abbott championed data centers for years, took millions from their developers, and is now scrambling to reverse course. Gina called for a moratorium from day one.
As Gina put it to The Nation: The data-center issue is the latest example of a governor doing the bidding of moneyed interests and not the people of Texas. And it is angering MAGA Republicans -- not country-club Republicans, not Chamber of Commerce Republicans. There is an opportunity for alliances to be forged when we are pursuing a populist agenda.
**Even Abbott 's own team is admitting this race is close.**
Abbott's longtime political strategist was asked about the tightening polls. His response: "Is it going to be close on Election Day? Yes." That's Abbott's own guy publicly conceding this goes to the wire. And when pressed on his best argument against Gina? He went to culture wars and lies on income tax votes -- not data centers, not schools, not the affordability crisis Abbott has presided over for twelve years. When culture wars are the best attack you can come up with, you're losing ground.
**The coalition winning this race doesn 't look like past Texas Democratic coalitions.**
Gina leads independents by 38 points in the Siena poll. She's winning women 57-40%, voters under 45 by 60-33%, and Gen Z 71-19%. She's pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans. In TX-15 -- a district Trump carried 58-41 -- a House Majority PAC poll shows Gina leading 52-47.
This is a cross-partisan, cross-regional majority being built in real time. _Gina is earning support from Texans who have never voted for a Democrat before in their lives._
**When Texas Democrats run strong, the whole map shifts.**
In 2018, when Beto lost the Senate race by just 2.6 points, that wave energy flipped 12 State House seats, 2 State Senate seats, and 2 congressional seats. And the stakes this cycle go even further: if Abbott wins another term, Republicans will redraw the congressional map again. Combined with seats Texas gains after the next Census, that could put nine or ten congressional seats permanently out of Democratic reach -- one-party control of Congress, likely for a generation. A governor who vetoes rigged maps changes all of that. As Gina said: _" We flip Texas, and it's over."_
**The bottom line.**
Six polls show Gina leading. One has us tied. Abbott is underwater on favorability and approval. Conservatives are crossing over to support our campaign. The polling average is under 2 points. Abbott's own strategist admits this race will be close.
_This race is winnable._ But Abbott is going to spend over $106 million to try to buy his lead back in the final few weeks of this race.
Gina has raised a fraction of Abbott's war chest. The only thing that closes the spending gap is donors who understand what's actually happening in Texas right now -- and decide this race is worth their investment.
We can win this. But only if people show up.
* * *
Greg Abbott has been in statewide office for 30 years. He has 98 percent name recognition. He started this campaign with $106 million in the bank. And he still can't grab onto an insurmountable lead in this race.
The only question is whether we have what it takes to close this out -- whether the people who believe Texas can change are willing to put real resources behind it in these final 11 days.

Thank you for believing in this fight,
Gina

Oct 23 | | | | | | | | | | | Hi y'all -- it's Gina. We're on the ground hitting cities from San Antonio to Odessa for my One Fight get out the vote (GOTV) tour. We're on college campuses and in the towns Abbott hardly ever visits. People are fed up with the status quo and ready for change in Texas. Young people on college campuses couldn't be more fired up about this race because they finally feel like they have a gubernatorial candidate committed to fighting for the things that matter most -- lowering costs, ending the data center takeover, and increasing access to healthcare. We're in the final 11 days of our race. The fact of the matter is, we are effectively tied against Greg Abbott. That means we are going to have to see record voter turnout in order to win in the few short days we have left before Election Day. But first, my team put together a memo that lays out the stakes of the race to help explain why your support is more critical than ever. We're almost at the finish line -- and I am so proud of how far we've come and all that we've managed to build in the past year, but we're not done yet. -- Gina OCTOBER 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV FROM: Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas TO: Interested Parties Let me tell you where this race actually stands -- because what's happening in Texas right now is something I don't think the national establishment fully understands yet. Gina Hinojosa is leading Greg Abbott in six of the most recent polls. That 's never happened before. This race is closer than ever but some people still don't believe we can win -- that's exactly why I'm writing this memo. And it's exactly why this race could slip away if we don't act. Here's the polling picture. This race has moved steadily and dramatically in Gina's direction since the spring: Texas Politics Project (April 2026): Abbott +5 TPOR (July 2026): Abbott +3, inside the margin of error N+ Univision (September 9): Tied 47-47, with Gina leading Latino voters by 12 ReconMR/Siena (September 17): Gina leads 49 -45 -- independents breaking for Gina 65-27 NPR/Marist (September 23): Gina leads 49 -46, winning independents 52-39, pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans NYT/Siena (October 4): Gina leads 49 -46, winning independents 55-39, and leading among Latino voters by 31 points YouGov (October 2026): Gina +1 GBAO Poll (October 13): Gina +2 UT/Texas Politics Project (October 14): Gina +1 Both RealClearPolitics and Nate Silver's Silver Bulletin have the polling average at about 2 points. This is a true toss-up. Abbott is outspending us 10 to 1 -- and he still isn't getting the result he wants. Between July 30 and September 8 alone, Abbott outspent Gina $28 million to $2 million on advertising. Over the full race, he's spent $47 million to our $5 million. Despite that, Gina leads in six of the most recent polls. Abbott's favorability has gone deeply negative -- 45% favorable, 53% unfavorable -- and his job approval has flipped the same way. He's even polling 13% unfavorable among his own Republicans. Abbott is a damaged incumbent with a nine-figure war chest. The only thing keeping this race from breaking open is the spending gap. But here's the truth: The more money Abbott spends lying about Gina's record, the more vulnerable we are. We have to raise more money to reach the voters who haven 't heard from us yet. Something real is happening on the ground -- and Republicans know it. Lifelong conservative voters are publicly breaking with Abbott over two issues. On education: conservative moms who backed Abbott before are now appearing at Gina's events, frustrated by a decade of voucher schemes and defunded public schools. Gina is running an ad featuring a self-described MAGA conservative who protested on January 6 -- and is now voting for Gina because of schools. On data centers: rural Republican protest groups -- including one in Lubbock led by Republicans -- are furious about unregulated expansion driving up electricity bills. Abbott championed data centers for years, took millions from their developers, and is now scrambling to reverse course. Gina called for a moratorium from day one. As Gina put it to The Nation: The data-center issue is the latest example of a governor doing the bidding of moneyed interests and not the people of Texas. And it is angering MAGA Republicans -- not country-club Republicans, not Chamber of Commerce Republicans. There is an opportunity for alliances to be forged when we are pursuing a populist agenda. Even Abbott 's own team is admitting this race is close. Abbott's longtime political strategist was asked about the tightening polls. His response: "Is it going to be close on Election Day? Yes." That's Abbott's own guy publicly conceding this goes to the wire. And when pressed on his best argument against Gina? He went to culture wars and lies on income tax votes -- not data centers, not schools, not the affordability crisis Abbott has presided over for twelve years. When culture wars are the best attack you can come up with, you're losing ground. The coalition winning this race doesn 't look like past Texas Democratic coalitions. Gina leads independents by 38 points in the Siena poll. She's winning women 57-40%, voters under 45 by 60-33%, and Gen Z 71-19%. She's pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans. In TX-15 -- a district Trump carried 58-41 -- a House Majority PAC poll shows Gina leading 52-47. This is a cross-partisan, cross-regional majority being built in real time. Gina is earning support from Texans who have never voted for a Democrat before in their lives. When Texas Democrats run strong, the whole map shifts. In 2018, when Beto lost the Senate race by just 2.6 points, that wave energy flipped 12 State House seats, 2 State Senate seats, and 2 congressional seats. And the stakes this cycle go even further: if Abbott wins another term, Republicans will redraw the congressional map again. Combined with seats Texas gains after the next Census, that could put nine or ten congressional seats permanently out of Democratic reach -- one-party control of Congress, likely for a generation. A governor who vetoes rigged maps changes all of that. As Gina said: " We flip Texas, and it's over." The bottom line. Six polls show Gina leading. One has us tied. Abbott is underwater on favorability and approval. Conservatives are crossing over to support our campaign. The polling average is under 2 points. Abbott's own strategist admits this race will be close. This race is winnable. But Abbott is going to spend over $106 million to try to buy his lead back in the final few weeks of this race. Gina has raised a fraction of Abbott's war chest. The only thing that closes the spending gap is donors who understand what's actually happening in Texas right now -- and decide this race is worth their investment. We can win this. But only if people show up. Greg Abbott has been in statewide office for 30 years. He has 98 percent name recognition. He started this campaign with $106 million in the bank. And he still can't grab onto an insurmountable lead in this race. The only question is whether we have what it takes to close this out -- whether the people who believe Texas can change are willing to put real resources behind it in these final 11 days. ** Thank you for believing in this fight, Gina | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Gina Hinojosa PO Box 300095, Austin, TX 78703 ? ?

It is an honor to carry that legacy forward every day—and to fight for Virginia's future. With just 11 days left until Election Day, we are getting ready to write the next chapter of this history. Every generation of Virginians has had a hand in building our democracy. Now, it’s our turn. clean_body: | | | | = | | | Today marks 175 years of the office of Lieutenant Governor in Virginia. I recently had the chance to look through a facsimile of Virginia’s 1851 Constitution—the very document that established the modern office of Lieutenant Governor—along with campaign broadsides from that era. Holding those pages is a powerful reminder of how long this story has been unfolding. For nearly two centuries, leaders have stepped forward to serve our Commonwealth, shape its government, and move Virginia forward. Today, 175 years later, I have the profound privilege of serving in an office whose history reaches back to that pivotal moment. It is an honor to carry that legacy forward every day—and to fight for Virginia's future. With just 11 days left until Election Day, we are getting ready to write the next chapter of this history. Every generation of Virginians has had a hand in building our democracy. Now, it’s our turn. But ensuring we have the resources to reach voters, defend our progress, and protect our future takes real grassroots power. = | | | = Thank you,Ghazala Hashmi P.S. Today is the final day of standard voter registration in Virginia. ## _**YOSEMITE IS _NOT_ FOR SALE! Your support is matched 3X to help stop Trump’s latest public lands giveaway, Peter.**_
---
| |
### [**_The Trump administration is negotiating a backroom deal to hand over land in Yosemite National Park to a private developer. Renew your LCV membership for just $15 today to protect our national parks >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/bxyvTV~4_)
---
| | Peter — Trump’s Department of the Interior is negotiating with a real estate firm that wants a private access road to connect its resort property to Yosemite National Park.
---
| | Their plan? Hand over part of Yosemite to the private developer in exchange for an I.O.U.
---
| | Since we first reached out with news of this backroom land deal, hundreds of LCV members from all over the country have stepped up to protect public lands. **Peter — I’m hoping we’ll hear from you today, too, because right now your support TRIPLES in impact. **
---
| | Yosemite belongs to _all of us_ — and it’s up to us to protect public lands like Yosemite for the public good.
---
| | [**_The best thing you can do right now to protect Yosemite from Trump’s attacks is to renew your membership today while this triple match is active. $15 is all it takes._**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/VXb6sXzpEdC~)
---
| | | [RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/-)
---
| | Our national parks exist so their extraordinary landscapes, wildlife, waterways, and ecosystems can be protected now and for future generations — not parceled off to give private access for the rich.
---
| | **But across the country, Trump is working to weaken or end protections for public lands, wildlife, the air we breathe, and the water we need to survive. **
---
| | Trump’s attacks on the environment are wildly unpopular in every part of the country. National parks have long been part of our national identity, transcending political parties and rallying support from _all of us_. That means we have to let Trump and his billionaire buddies know: we're watching and we won't let our parks be sold off without a fight.
---
| | We only have a shot when we stand together. **Please, let’s stand up for Yosemite and all of our parks and public lands. **
---
| | [**_Join us by renewing your membership for just $15 as LCV continues to work to protect Yosemite and all public lands from land grabs by greedy billionaires. Right now, the impact of your support TRIPLES._**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_)

News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.

---
| A message from Congressional District 2 Candidate Brinker Harding...
---
| Fellow Republicans, Two years ago, this seat was decided by fewer than two points, and this year will be just as close. Denise Powell's answer to everything is another tax. She'd have let the largest tax increase since World War II take a bite out of your paycheck, and she'd keep taxing the Social Security you spent a lifetime earning. Her campaign runs on dark money, and her values are just as far from home. I believe you know how to spend your money better than Washington does, and I've governed that way. On the City Council, we balanced the budget every year and cut the property tax levy three times, keeping more money in your pocket. I'll bring that same discipline to Congress and make Washington answer to you. Please make a plan to vote, whether that's early in person or on Election Day. Remind your friends and family to vote as well, close races are won one conversation at a time. Brinker Harding
---
| Letter from the Chair...
---
| Friends,
Eleven days. This is not the time to tap the brakes. This is the time to push the gas pedal to the floor. Out-of-state money is pouring into Nebraska for Denise Powell and Dan Osborn, and the Left is betting Republicans will get comfortable and coast to the finish line. We can't let that happen. Every race on this ballot, from the U.S. Senate down to the power board, comes down to who shows up and who brings their neighbors with them.
The choice in front of Nebraskans could not be clearer. Democrats want bigger government, more spending, and more decisions made in Washington by people who have never set foot in our state. We believe Nebraskans know how to run their own lives, their own businesses, and their own families. They fought voter ID. We passed it. They want to keep feeding a system that sends tax bills higher every year. They want to tell your kids what to think. We want parents in charge of their children's education and our girls protected in their own sports.
So let's finish this. If you've already voted, thank you. Now call three people this weekend and make sure they vote too. If your mail ballot is still on the counter, drop it off at your county election office or drop box instead of mailing it this late. Early voting is open at your county election office through November 2, and polls are open Tuesday, November 3. Bring your photo ID. And if you can spare a few hours, knock on one more neighborhood or make one more round of calls.
We did not come this far to fall short at the finish line. Eleven days. Foot on the gas. Let's bring it home.

Together we win!
In Liberty and in Truth,
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

## The Arbitrators of the Truth Have an Accountability Problem
When conservative public figures make even the slightest verbal misstep or administrative oversight, mainstream media immediately deploy breaking news banners, demand instant press-room apologies, and run week-long investigative cycles.
Yet, when the legacy press gets caught manufacturing false narratives out of thin air, those same high standards instantly vanish.
In just a single week, we witnessed three of the biggest outlets in corporate media - NBC News, ABC News, and POLITICO - got caught red-handed pushing completely false reporting on high-profile targets.
From claiming an FBI Director landed in Russia while he was standing on a stage in Virginia, to quietly deleting bogus reports about military contracts, to framing false insider gossip as a minor "mischaracterization" \- the corporate press has refined the art of dodging responsibility.

Hey folks,
I'm furious about this one.
Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign is using Amy Acton's estranged mother--and the trauma of Acton's childhood, in an attack ad against her. And instead of condemning it, Donald Trump and J.D. Vance are defending it. This isn't normal politics. This is depravity.
* [**00:01:44**] We get into the attack ad against Amy Acton, the painful history behind it, and why I think everyone needs to understand exactly what Republicans are weaponizing here.
* [**00:04:35**] I react to the ad itself, and explain why, after nearly two decades in politics, this crosses a line I never imagined a major campaign would cross.
* [**00:07:43**] We look at reporting that court records and contemporaneous accounts corroborate key parts of Acton's story, despite the claims being made against her.
* [**00:10:14**] J.D. Vance responds to the controversy, and somehow seems more bothered by Republicans criticizing the ad than by what the ad actually does.
* [**00:13:34**] This becomes bigger than one disgusting campaign tactic: when do Americans finally decide enough is enough with the cruelty, corruption, desperation, and degradation of our politics?

There are campaign attacks, and then there are moments that tell you something deeper about the people seeking power. This is one of those moments. Amy Acton's childhood trauma should never have become political ammunition, and every politician willing to defend that choice should have to answer for it. We have a chance to reject this kind of politics at the ballot box. **If you value independent media that refuses to normalize cruelty like this, help me keep fighting.**

name: Mary Peltola
subject: The Department of Justice wants to overturn Alaska’s election…before it happens
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
DC people want to play partisan games while I am fighting for Alaska’s future.
Peter, it’s Mary Peltola. I want you to hear this from me:
The Trump Administration is suing preemptively to try to keep Dan Sullivan in power because they're terrified he’ll lose this race in 11 days.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261023-2-partner-mp.G2U4tU&amount=5&refcode=em20261023-1249&t=1&akid=1249%2E34582%2EMuxxuH)
Look, Peter, I’m not used to this Lower 48 hyperpartisan BS.
It’s not how we do things in Alaska. Where I’m from in the Bush, there’s a big premium on respect. We depend on each other too much to burn bridges over political differences.
But if they think I won’t fight back when DC people try to play partisan games with our future, they’ve got another thing coming.
I’m running to take on the rigged DC system that’s hurting all of us, and I won’t let this sham stop me.
But the truth is, the only way we’re going to make sure every single Alaskan’s voice is heard over the next 11 days is together. That's why I need all hands on deck right now to respond.
**[If you’re with me, please split a $5 contribution between my campaign and Small Town PAC. With lots of people like you stepping up, we can overcome any obstacle and take this fight for fish, family, freedom to DC.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261023-2-partner-mp.G2U4tU&amount=5&refcode=em20261023-1249&t=2&akid=1249%2E34582%2EMuxxuH)**

Together,
Mary

| | Peter, This week, I visited the Eloy Detention Center in Arizona alongside my colleagues Reps. Adelita Grijalva, Yassamin Ansari, and advocates from Reproductive Freedom for All. **What I heard from women detained inside this facility was horrifying.** I met **Maria Alejandra Valero Brinez** , a 24-year-old woman who is five months pregnant. Three years ago, she suffered a stillbirth at eight months. Now, she is experiencing complications similar to those that threatened her previous pregnancy. Maria told us she has experienced abnormal bleeding, has been taken to the emergency room multiple times, and is not receiving regular prenatal care. She said she isn't consistently receiving the additional food prescribed for her pregnancy. And she described having to use the two dollars she earns per day working in the facility to purchase one small bottle of clean drinking water. **She is carrying a high-risk pregnancy while being denied the consistent medical care, nutrition, and basic necessities she needs to stay healthy.** As a physician, I know how dangerous these complications can be. Without appropriate monitoring and treatment, she faces a potentially life-threatening hemorrhage and risk to her baby. She needs access to an OB-GYN and comprehensive prenatal care, not a detention facility where she must wait for a medical emergency to receive attention. And Maria's experience is not an isolated allegation. Other detainees at Eloy have reported inadequate medical care, unsafe conditions, and even pregnancy loss. **No one should be held in immigration detention while pregnant. No one should have to work for access to clean drinking water. And no one should have to fear that asking for medical care or expressing emotional distress will result in punishment.** As a member of Congress, I have a responsibility to conduct oversight of the agencies and private contractors operating these facilities. clean_body: | | | | | Peter, This week, I visited the Eloy Detention Center in Arizona alongside my colleagues Reps. Adelita Grijalva, Yassamin Ansari, and advocates from Reproductive Freedom for All. What I heard from women detained inside this facility was horrifying. I met Maria Alejandra Valero Brinez , a 24-year-old woman who is five months pregnant. Three years ago, she suffered a stillbirth at eight months. Now, she is experiencing complications similar to those that threatened her previous pregnancy. Maria told us she has experienced abnormal bleeding, has been taken to the emergency room multiple times, and is not receiving regular prenatal care. She said she isn't consistently receiving the additional food prescribed for her pregnancy. And she described having to use the two dollars she earns per day working in the facility to purchase one small bottle of clean drinking water. She is carrying a high-risk pregnancy while being denied the consistent medical care, nutrition, and basic necessities she needs to stay healthy. As a physician, I know how dangerous these complications can be. Without appropriate monitoring and treatment, she faces a potentially life-threatening hemorrhage and risk to her baby. She needs access to an OB-GYN and comprehensive prenatal care, not a detention facility where she must wait for a medical emergency to receive attention. And Maria's experience is not an isolated allegation. Other detainees at Eloy have reported inadequate medical care, unsafe conditions, and even pregnancy loss. No one should be held in immigration detention while pregnant. No one should have to work for access to clean drinking water. And no one should have to fear that asking for medical care or expressing emotional distress will result in punishment. As a member of Congress, I have a responsibility to conduct oversight of the agencies and private contractors operating these facilities. As a physician, I have an obligation to speak out when people's lives and health are being put at risk. I am demanding the immediate release of Maria and anyone who’s pregnant held in ICE detention. Pregnancy should never be a condition endured behind bars, and no one should have to risk their life or the life of their baby because our government refuses to provide appropriate care. | | | | | | I will continue fighting to expose abuses at Eloy, demand accountability from ICE and the private contractors profiting from detention, and work to end this inhumane system. Every person deserves dignity and to have their basic rights protected. No exceptions. Abolish ICE.
