clean_body: Military families break their silence on this illegal war. | | Peter, As I write this, rumors are swirling that the United States is about to launch a fresh wave of strikes on Iran, with reporting from allies in the region that they've been alerted ahead of the impending action. Before the bombs start falling again, we need to look back at what this war has already cost us. And the ledger is missing a lot of data the American people deserve to know. Today's update makes it five straight weeks of writing to you because this administration got caught lying about the devastation of Trump's illegal war in Iran. This week our justifiably fed-up troops started talking. Troops and military families just handed VoteVets and MeidasTouch dozens of photos the Pentagon never wanted you to see. Burned aircraft on the tarmac. Bombed-out barracks and dining halls. Our service members in the UAE found out their own war had started by watching the news. Their protection plan amounted to digging their own foxholes. | “We are sitting ducks,” one service member said. “We had no defense against the drones,” said another. A military spouse in Bahrain said it best: “We were used as pawns in the war.” Evacuation planes waited on the tarmac while the Pentagon refused to make the call because leaving would look bad on the news. An American contractor’s wife watched Iranian missiles level the building next door, then escaped through Saudi Arabia with zero help from her own government. Her words should haunt every one of us: “As an American citizen, I felt completely abandoned.” | I spent 20 years flying air operations including many combat missions. There is no world in which we would not have taken steps to ensure our own people were secure before the first bomb fell. The unqualified minds running the Pentagon fired the experienced planners who would have objected, then launched a war with American families still in the blast radius. The war’s official cost leaves out billions in hidden damage to bases and aircraft. Congress never declared or funded this war, so families escaping it burned their own savings and got denied the benefits they earned. All because a childish president did not want to look bad in primetime. Trump chose the headline over the evacuation, the cover-up over the casualty rolls, and his own image over every military family hiding from explosions. Keith Self swore the same oath those troops did – the same oath I took – and he has betrayed it. He blocked every chance to vote on this war and cheered its draft-dodging architect from his taxpayer-funded seat. Veterans on our own campaign team deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan, and they will tell you these photos match the worst of what they saw there. Troy here - take a walk down memory lane with me for a second.
This is me as a kid. I don't remember the exact moment the photo was taken, but I probably caught that fish with my dad. We didn't spend a whole lot of time together when I was growing up because he worked such long hours out in the woods, but I really loved the time we did get.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4c69e8e-b0a3-4cdb-b345-e9ed997876ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fast forward a little more than a decade, and this is me again, this time with two sons of my own. I hate that I didn't spend a whole lot of time with them growing up either, because just like my dad, I was out in the woods working the same long hours to try to make ends meet.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4c69e8e-b0a3-4cdb-b345-e9ed997876ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **I 've been trying to put this into words for a long time.**
When we're living in a system that's rigged to benefit the super-rich -- a system that forces us to work 80-hour weeks to put food on the table, or take two or three jobs at a time to afford health insurance -- we're losing a whole lot more than just money.
_We 're losing what little time we have with our families._
### **I 'm still trying to make up for a life lost with my kids.**
When my boys were growing up, times were tough for our family. There was never enough money, and I was spending all my time out on the road, driving hours to chase down logging jobs that I needed if we were gonna be able to get by.
Leaving home before sunrise, never getting back before sunset, spending nights sitting around the kitchen table looking at the bills piling up, and doing it all again the next day.
### **You 're bone-tired, and it takes a toll on your family.**
And it's not just me. I see it everywhere I go: people constantly having to chase down money for the next medical bill, the rent that's always due, the damn groceries that just keep getting more expensive -- it gets so bad there's no time left for living life.
The oligarchy's greatest robbery from the working class is our time.**** The people in power see working-class folks as nothing more than a commodity.
### **This billionaire economy is not just about taking our money. It is about taking pieces of our lives away from us.**
So when I'm out on the road across Maine, and I'm talking to folks about the stakes of this election and what I'm fighting for, I want to be clear:
Yes, I'm fighting for higher wages and lower costs, for affordable healthcare and tax breaks for working families.
**And what all of that really means is I 'm** _**fighting for the things that make your life worth living**_**.**
That's what this is all about.
It's what I've been fighting for my whole life, and it's what I'll fight for in the U.S. Senate, if you can help me get there.
**[If you 're in a position to donate, will you chip in right now to support this fight? We're up against tens of millions of dollars in MAGA dark money trying to protect Susan Collins, not to mention the money pouring in from Elon Musk, and we're already being outspent.](https://substack.com/redirect/f4c69e8e-b0a3-4cdb-b345-e9ed997876ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE NOW ->](https://substack.com/redirect/f4c69e8e-b0a3-4cdb-b345-e9ed997876ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for being a part of this team, however you can.
--Troy

name: Darline Graham
subject: My radical opponent raised $9 million
body:
The latest fundraising numbers are out in South Carolina. My opponent raised $9 million in just three months. |
---
Fellow Patriot - Annie Andrews just posted her latest fundraising numbers from the last quarter.

**$9 million.
In three months.
That's nearly $100,000 a day.
Every day.**
And she's spending every cent of it to hide her radical record. She has flip-flopped on every issue South Carolinians care about, and now she's flooding the airwaves to make you forget it.

Look at who's backing her: Mark Hamill. John Goodman. Carole King. Jeff Goldblum. Hollywood and the far left have decided South Carolina's Senate seat is for sale.

Here's the hard truth: _we were outraised last quarter._

We didn't have three full months. We entered this race late and had to turn a U.S. Senate campaign into an all-out sprint. We've been closing the gap ever since, but it doesn't close by itself.

Early voting is already underway here in South Carolina. Ballots are being cast right now. Every ad we can't afford, and every undecided voter we can't reach is a vote we may never get back.

That's why I'm asking you directly. **[Will you chip in $20 or $30 right now?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9d93961b3f0240028d49e9d7bbfdbc47&_e=LTMhevhS0mZ-Oh8ismI9bOa7xQ71qO5h3uYbVXgu4s7H5KkxcDILbHuUBIYBt2wN-qT1W1aGTFsK1Ewlww2mdmA3P2oUFRTkKIc_nCVBdHI4mpPRfSwMFQ0OkgjrIrOUaaQ0RDuYJiawZwLC2LsjiFzqCje-7mL7BwHnOEQPUC9i5mIf4mdvaa0f6VwogjLVawfArc79mGIArGnDXwG5YTNK5UrjZfUqJf6uZUzQP1V7sOzKMjlbLrJ5DDxvYWb6L-I4IN6D1jfoYSGhbQAN77Unku2AbruZLva9CuYSBL7OccCdjs3Q-Ico165Nuh1ooMHrh3paELWZ4AMSgDUOk3PffvhdQX_P5xZWYOUPOo0fobj6FS3GooxXhpWEk061aaS96VOFGRNlF3PfUFSCrKXPTSl9EjR-LiAUc14GE24dwhpRxsRJK1kJJF1PYBF6njL8-htdtj8eQqhwAMgCchZQbg0pKhezzb_mtDydshLCkG-Ayxgb3v905l3NGOviqeL8cOEgZjxih8tq1g0p_Ohq8debDZcRrvIMf0-fOAMFHZJ3qHfZXyxsjSxRLOVqVE10C9BNb5vDm0bp-TfNBSqIw_Z0UoRZ3SaazGqLPsSr8i_LI7Sx1rS6Ej911K0-57tjbk3XXTYOh36bwau1xmK9pDRkVfVvaM-Q_KnN0GiI4BxiNNQPmhSIJLfRnWkjfZg0dtq_rPHluMdz0XcQTLdPWUSMzCHPKsofqZbelx7VurMHjiUlGr9YvXtZbfMdQ8HtrK37c0mHrxwJjN_W1w%3D%3D)**

Every dollar goes straight to the work that decides close races in the final stretch:
* Last-minute ads to answer her attacks

It's been a long week. Before you log off, I wanted to send you a quick note thanking you.
Thousands of hardworking Americans have already stepped up to support this campaign. And ever since my debate on Monday night, contributions have _skyrocketed_.
It's an uphill battle to topple the status quo here in Kentucky. But I'm not fazed, because I know that real lives depend on the work we're doing.
Seeing Kentuckians hear our message, connect with our movement, and chip in even just $1 _- that's what powers this campaign forward._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de6d9fb5-ef3c-4c1a-ae5e-5a9201566473?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Connecting with voters like you means the world to me._
From healthcare to education to Social Security, meaningful change is underway.
This week has confirmed what I already knew: when our message reaches working families across Kentucky, they become believers. So in this final stretch, I'm asking for your continued support to keep pushing it out.
**I don 't have deep pockets like my opponent, but with every donation, this movement becomes harder to beat. Will you capitalize on this momentum and chip in just $5 or more before the week is over?**

_Charles Booker_

Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to flip Congress in 11 days. Derek, we pulled your supporter record and noticed that you haven’t donated to the DNC yet this year. Period.** The Justice Department should not be politicized in any way shape or form — least of all to go after the President’s perceived political opponents or enemies. Last week, in Tiananmen Square, China put on a chilling display of military power.

Fighter jets, tanks, AI-guided drones — all paraded under the red flag, in front of Vladimir Putin, Kim Jong Un, and more than two dozen world leaders.

_“They were hoping I was watching,”_ he said. _“And I was watching.”_

A warning shot at America. A not-so-subtle message to the United States — and to every American who still believes we call the shots.

The world is realigning. China. Russia. India. They’re drawing closer. And Trump’s high-risk trade policies are pushing them into each other’s arms.

The U.S. is becoming isolated and distrusted under our glorious leader.

And we’re drowning in debt – $21 billion a day added and growing.

And this Chinese parade – as symbolic as it was strategic – signals that the world may be entering a post-American financial era.

One where the dollar no longer dominates... and U.S. influence is no longer guaranteed.

The White House won’t admit it, but the signs are everywhere.

Foreign alliances are being formed without us... economic blocks are shifting against us... our tariffs are backfiring and capital is fleeing the country... debt is exploding past $37 trillion with no plans to stop it.

Washington’s Debt Grew by $133 Billion in Six Days This Month. Meanwhile, the World’s Other Powers Are Building Systems Without the Dollar.
U.S. national debt hit a record $40.3 trillion in October. The dollar’s share of world reserves has fallen to 57%. China, Russia and India have spent the past year drawing closer, and in December, world leaders meet in Miami. The shift away from a dollar-centered world isn’t a prediction. It’s a trend you can measure.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated

For 80 years, the United States sat at the center of the global financial system. The dollar was the currency everyone needed, and American debt was the asset everyone wanted. That position has never been more valuable, or more questioned, than it is right now.
The evidence board
| | The Numbers

| EVIDENCE

| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the dollar.** The dollar’s share of global central bank reserves fell from about 71% around 2000 to 57% in early 2026, according to the IMF.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the alignment.** In September 2025, Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong Un stood beside Xi Jinping at a massive military parade in Beijing, days after leaders including India’s Narendra Modi gathered at a summit in Tianjin.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the calendar.** After a state visit by Xi in September, Washington extended its trade truce with China through January 10. G20 leaders meet at Trump’s Doral resort on December 14 and 15.

---
A country that borrows more than $20 billion a day depends on the rest of the world wanting its money. Every step other powers take toward their own payment systems and reserves chips away at that. For savers, the question isn’t whether the dollar disappears. It’s how much buying power it loses along the way.

Fighter jets, tanks, AI-guided drones — all paraded under the red flag, in front of Vladimir Putin, Kim Jong Un, and more than two dozen world leaders. Meanwhile, in Washington, President Trump watched. “They were hoping I was watching,” he said. “And I was watching.” But what he didn’t say matters more. Because while the media calls it a “celebration,” those of us paying attention know what it really was: A warning shot at America. A not-so-subtle message to the United States — and to every American who still believes we call the shots. The world is realigning. China. Russia. India. They’re drawing closer. And Trump’s high-risk trade policies are pushing them into each other’s arms. The U.S. is becoming isolated and distrusted under our glorious leader. And we’re drowning in debt – $21 billion a day added and growing. And this Chinese parade – as symbolic as it was strategic – signals that the world may be entering a post-American financial era. One where the dollar no longer dominates... and U.S. influence is no longer guaranteed. The White House won’t admit it, but the signs are everywhere. Foreign alliances are being formed without us... economic blocks are shifting against us... our tariffs are backfiring and capital is fleeing the country... debt is exploding past $37 trillion with no plans to stop it. For those looking to protect themselves as this global power shift takes place... I highly suggest you watch from Porter Stansberry. In it, he details exactly how this new global power structure could impact your finances... and what he believes every American must do to protect their money, when America’s 2026 budget exposes just how bad things have become. . | | | | Case File No DRT-ED-REALIGN · Special File · The Realignment Washington’s Debt Grew by $133 Billion in Six Days This Month. Meanwhile, the World’s Other Powers Are Building Systems Without the Dollar. U.S. national debt hit a record $40.3 trillion in October. The dollar’s share of world reserves has fallen to 57%. China, Russia and India have spent the past year drawing closer, and in December, world leaders meet in Miami. The shift away from a dollar-centered world isn’t a prediction. It’s a trend you can measure. Threat level 4/5 — Elevated | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|--- | For 80 years, the United States sat at the center of the global financial system. The dollar was the currency everyone needed, and American debt was the asset everyone wanted. That position has never been more valuable, or more questioned, than it is right now. The evidence board | | The Numbers ---|--- | EVIDENCE Exhibit A — the debt. U.S. public debt hit a record of about $40.3 trillion on October 8, up roughly $133 billion in six days, according to Treasury data. | EVIDENCE Exhibit B — the dollar. The dollar’s share of global central bank reserves fell from about 71% around 2000 to 57% in early 2026, according to the IMF. | EVIDENCE Exhibit C — the alignment. In September 2025, Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong Un stood beside Xi Jinping at a massive military parade in Beijing, days after leaders including India’s Narendra Modi gathered at a summit in Tianjin. | EVIDENCE Exhibit D — the calendar. After a state visit by Xi in September, Washington extended its trade truce with China through January 10. G20 leaders meet at Trump’s Doral resort on December 14 and 15. | OUR THEORY A country that borrows more than $20 billion a day depends on the rest of the world wanting its money. Every step other powers take toward their own payment systems and reserves chips away at that. For savers, the question isn’t whether the dollar disappears. It’s how much buying power it loses along the way. Connected file | | Who Controls Your Money ---|--- As the dollar’s role changes, so does the plumbing behind it. The Federal Reserve’s FedNow instant-payment system, launched in July 2023, now counts more than 1,800 banks and credit unions. In January 2025, President Trump signed an executive order barring work on a U.S. central bank digital currency. Even so, many Americans are looking for ways to keep part of their savings outside the banking system. | | Sponsored by Weiss Ratings But they are making one critical mistake in the process. You see, most folks assume that to truly protect your money from government surveillance, you need a shady Cayman Islands trust, a complex offshore LLC or a secret Swiss bank account. Nothing could be further from the truth. It takes your money completely "off the grid" ... but NOT offshore. | Why it matters to you | | What This Means for Your Savings ---|--- | → | Debt keeps compounding. Interest costs make every new dollar of borrowing harder to carry. ---|--- | → | Buying power is the real risk. A weaker dollar quietly shrinks what your savings can buy. ---|--- | → | Position before the headlines. Big monetary shifts are obvious only in hindsight. ---|--- | Classification Shift measurable The world isn’t abandoning the dollar overnight. But every number that matters is moving in the same direction, and December puts the world’s biggest economies in one room. Connected file | | A Rearming World ---|--- A more divided world is also a more heavily armed one. U.S. national defense spending has climbed to about $1 trillion, and militaries around the world are racing to rebuild stockpiles. For many critical parts, the Pentagon depends on a single supplier.
